profile.headline: Software Engineer at Travelers
profile.summary:
Thoughtful creative whose curiosity has led to the technology sector and the next level of problem solving with the belief that technology, when used for good, has the power to change our lives for the better.

I am a science nerd, a teacher, a thoughtful creative but most of all a perpetual learner. 

My whole life, I have been fascinated with the world and the information held within. Over the years I have developed a scientific mindset that now permeates my approach to every aspect of my life. I am constantly observing, questioning, experimenting, increasing my knowledge and revising my thinking. Whether it’s technology, photography, business strategy, marketing, hiking in the great outdoors or reading a new book, I am thoughtfully exploring the interconnectedness of life. 

I am passionate about learning and helping others learn. Learning opens new doors and provides opportunities that we never would have considered. I love that the era we live in is filled with data and information at our fingertips – it can be daunting but the possibilities are endless. I enjoy helping others discover those new possibilities in life and business.

When I am not working I enjoy cooking up a new recipe, discovering a new restaurant, hiking, camping, sewing, and running.

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.locationName: St Paul, Minnesota, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineering Student
positions.description:
•	Solo Project: Hangry! (Serving up Relevant Restaurants, when you need them most.)
•	Built With: React, Redux, Redux-saga, Node.js, Espress.js, Google Places API, PostgreSQL
•	Problem: When hungry, I cannot recall the list of restaurants I am excited about trying, so I end up eating at the same places.
•	Solution: A web application designed to serve up saved restaurants to store and organize a user’s restaurants for immediate retrieval when you are too hungry to think straight. Leveraging Google’s places api, users can view details, save, and categorize restaurants. When user adds a restaurant, the card populates with additional info about the location and the user can add their own notes to keep track of their personal experience with that restaurant.  
•	Group Project: Voila
•	Built With: React, Redux, Redux-saga, Node.js, Espress.js, PostgreSQL, Heroku, Material UI
•	Client – Voila (James Andersen) – A real estate agent who wanted a tracking application for real estate buyers to provide transparency and peace of mind during the real estate process. 
•	Our team of 5 Prime developers designed and developed a mobile first web application allowing users to visualize where they are at in the buying process, what steps are and are not complete. Users can look forward to see what steps are upcoming, when they need to be active in providing information and documentation and when steps are awaiting completion by other parties. The agent administrator can mark each of the buyer’s journey complete, manage their clients, additional administrators and offer vendors (like insurance or inspection partners). 
•	I led the team on database structures, data queries and setting up server api routes. I also worked on some font-end views allowing a buyer to view a list of insurance agents and inspection partners provided by Voila and upload their selections to the application.

positions.title: Office Associate
positions.description:
•	Produced insurance quotes and policies while clarifying insurance jargon for clients.
•	Addressed questions and concerns on current client policies to ensure client was making the best decision for themselves and their circumstances. 
•	Alleviated client concern while helping file claims and detailing next steps to expect in the claims process. 
•	Collaborated with our internal team on how to clearly deliver information on company changes to our clients in an easy to understand way.

positions.title: Internal Project Coordinator
positions.description:
•	Managed 100+ special order flooring projects simultaneously from materials ordering through install by coordinating with internal departments, installers, external business partners and clients.
•	Identified and made recommendations for loss prevention before project was executed. 
•	Delivered client care throughout the life of the project with regular communication on project status.

positions.title: Owner/Photographer/Business Manager
positions.description:
Viveria is a compilation, a sense, a feeling, of the words vivé and aria. Viveria is our vision; a vision of celebrated life; the good, the wonderful, the beautiful, the mundane, the extraordinary, the divine. Everyone’s life has a rhythm, a rhyme, a melody; whether your personality is a calculated waltz, a free-form jazz, a simply country melody or even a spicy salsa, your life is worth celebrating, enjoying, and living to the fullest! We want this name, who we are, and our business to join in the celebration of lives lived. 

At Viveia Photography, in addition to photographing I am responsible for designing, implementing and managing our daily business processes. I manage our brand through a variety of avenues including the use of social media outlets such as blogging and Facebook, maintaining our website and content, producing printed marketing materials, and developing the packaging for our products. I am the primary communicator for Viviera Photography and connect with our clients through phone, email and in person. I develop and organize the photography plan based on client personality and preferences, time allotment, and location(s) available. I make sure our clients are well taken care of each step along the way.

positions.title: ESL Paraprofessional
positions.description: As a paraprofessional I had the opportunity to work with students one-on-one and in small groups. The students I worked with were a part of the English as a Second Language (ESL) program at the school as they were learning English and participating in regular level high school classes. I enjoyed being able to take time to really get to know my students as I supported them in their science course work. I provided additional before and after school tutoring where students could come and get help with any of their subjects. I worked with students from many different ethnic backgrounds and enjoyed learning about the backgrounds of others who make up my community.

volunteerExperiences.description: I participate in the Scholars program which is a one-on-one tutoring/mentoring program that serves students in grades K-5.  The Scholars program focuses on helping low-income students build academic skills, gain confidence, and form positive relationships. It is a weekly highlight of mine to be a part of the energy of a room full of youth and mentors connecting, learning, and growing!
